Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in the very first step by incorrectly identifying the director of the film "The Gallant Lords Of Bois-Doré" (Les Quatre Charlots mousquetaires) as André Hunebelle. In reality, the director of this 1952 film is Pierre Prévert. While the subsequent steps correctly gathered biographical data for André Hunebelle (who did die in Nice), this data is irrelevant to the original question because the subject was misidentified from the start. The entire process was built on a false premise created by the Planner's initial hallucination.
